[An Accountable Answering of Assorted Queries from Rhodes Island Operators on the Harvesting of Blood Bank Samples]
The elements of Rhodes Island's physical examinations are made available to all examinees, and are added or removed as per the examinee's wishes. All procedures and processes are completely transparent, and no part of them is in any way deceptive.
We keep strict confidentiality on patient information, and our independently founded blood bank has not, to this day, lost a single blood sample. Yes, not once.
Rhodes Island has confidence that we keep these samples safe under comprehensive surveillance, and it is only during treatment of disease that... what? Who's the supervisor of the bank?
Ahem. That would be Dr. Warfarin, one of Rhodes Island's most longstanding members.
No one could ever steal blood samples from under a Vampire's nose. I believe that it is precisely because Dr. Warfarin serves as its supervisor that we can confidently conclude that Rhodes Island's blood bank is not under any external threat.
[Extract from Warfarin's diary]
Blood tests on the new operators finished today. Haven't we had a few too many new ops lately? Feline, Perro, Liberi, Sarkaz... one lone doctor drawing all these vials from all these people... At first I was stirring a little at the scent, but by the end I was almost sick of the sight of it.
Kal'tsit really needs to laud me for my paranormal self-control. Forget all the young breeds running amok out there these days... Not even the old guard of our race could match my endurance.
...Forget that, actually. Comparing yourself to them at anything is stupid.
Back to the topic at hand. Collecting a few extra samples while I'm off the clock should be fine, right? That Skadi op, not to mention Specter and Gladiia... it's not every day we have so many gathered aboard. It's too good a chance to pass up!
Also, the Doctor.
Oh, the Doctor. Just a glance makes my researcher's heart tickle. It's so strange... where does that scent come from? Why am I so strongly drawn to it? Do other Vampires have the same reaction? Does Closure... Actually, never mind Closure. She's an exception.
If my judgment is correct, the Doctor's body should be hiding some kind of secret. I bet Kal'tsit knows it, but she keeps tight lips, and she wouldn't want anyone else to go digging.
Oh, that Kal'tsit! Kal'tsit! How can you dangle a chance to bare the truth in front of me like this, then forbid me from looking into it?
Come to think of it, she seems less uptight lately. What if I just... found a chance and gave it a shot?
Hmm... I'll need to plan this one out...
